page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at the top left, page number at the top right. Headings LVIII, LIX and LX are set as numbered lines of their own. Gathering signature at the foot left.

main_text.l: giofis, vt funt nimia superstitione impatien-
tes, infectetur etiam maledictis, & vix lecto
fortasse principio, affligat, proiiciat, execretur,
seq; inexpiabili scelere contaminari, atque a-
stringi putet, si haec aut legat patienter aut audiat. lib.5.cap.1.
LVIII:
Ab his, si fieri poteft, humanitatis iure po-
stulamus, ut non prius damnent quàm vniuer-
sa cognouerint. Sed noui hominum pertina-
ciam: nunquam impetrabimus. Timent e-
nim ne à nobis reuicti, manus dare aliquando,
clamante ipsa veritate, cogantur. Obstrepunt
igitur, & intercedunt ne audiant, & oculos su-
os opprimunt, ne lumen videant, quod offeri-
mus. &c. ibidem:
LIX:
Audent homines improbissimi iustitiae fa-
cere mentionem, qui feras immanitate vin-
cunt, qui placidissimum Dei gregem vastant. cap.9.
LX:
Nullus pudor apud eos superest, à quibus
abest omnis humanitas, & retorquent in ho-
mines iustos conuitia sibi congruentia. Impios
enim vocant, ipsi scilicet pii & ab humano san-
guine abhorrentes, cùm si & actus suos confi-
derent & illorum, quos tanquam impios dam-
nant, iam intelligent quàm mendaces sint: &
iis omnibus, quae aduersus bonos aut dicunt
aut faciunt, digniores. ibidem.

page.notes: The first word of the page is a fragment ("giofis") whose start is cut off at the left edge; the first letters are doubtful and may be "ingeniosis" or similar, so the fragment is kept as it stands. "confi-derent" is printed with the hyphen after "confi-", which looks like a printing error for "consi-derent"; left as printed. The gathering signature "F 2" is read as "F ij". Running head reads "CENTVRIA II." Two references in italics ("lib.5.cap.1.", "cap.9.") stand on their own lines as printed.
